description: This is a unit test class for the EmployeeDirectoryModel within the OrangeHRM Corporate Directory plugin. It tests the conversion of an Employee entity to an array representation, verifying correct serialization of employee data including job title, name, and termination info.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryModelTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeDirectoryModel, testing the serialization of Employee entity data into an array.

methods.name: testToArray
methods.description: Tests the toArray() method of EmployeeDirectoryModel, verifying that the employee data is correctly serialized into an array with expected structure and content.
